HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RONGON MUKHOPADHYAY HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH

For the Appellant(s) : Mr. Jitendra Shankar Singh, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shiv Shankar Kumar, A.P.P --------
04/ Dated 08.05.2025 I.A. No. 4808 of 2025 Heard Mr. Jitendra Shankar Singh, learned counsel for the appellant and Mr. Shiv Shankar Kumar, learned A.P.P on behalf of the State.
This interlocutory application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.

The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for ten years alongwith a fine of Rs.50,000/-.
It has been alleged that the appellant had committed rape upon the victim.

Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that it is an admitted fact that the marriage of the appellant was solemnized with the victim on 16.05.2021 and in the year of 2022, she had instituted a case.
It has further been submitted that the victim was staying in the house of the appellant.
Learned counsel further submits while referring to the evidence of P.W.4 that the age of the victim has been assessed to be 17-18 years.
Learned A.P.P has opposed the prayer for bail of the appellant.

On consideration of the fact that it appears that there was a love affair between the appellant and the victim and the F.I.R was Sahbaj Khan vs The State Of Jharkhand on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183874311/
1 instituted after she had solemnized the marriage with the appellant, we are inclined to admit the appellant on bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, during the pendency of this appeal, the appellant is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Rs. Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge POCSO, Latehar, in connection with Special POCSO Case No.03/2023.
The aforesaid I.A. stands allowed and disposed of.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J.) (Ambuj Nath, J.) BS-Saurav/-
